meta.name: storyboard
meta.description: Create a six-frame storyboard that shows a user's journey from problem to solution. Use when you need a fast narrative for alignment, concept reviews, or demos.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用六格故事板快速呈现用户从问题到解决的旅程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在团队中快速对齐用户故事或概念方案
copy.tagline_en: Create a six-frame storyboard showing a user's journey from problem to solution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly align user stories or concepts with your team

howto.what: Claude 会引导你回答 7 个问题，然后生成一个 6 帧故事板，展示用户从问题到解决方案的旅程。每帧包含文字描述和视觉建议（默认是粗马克笔素描风格）。
howto.when: 当你需要快速叙事来对齐团队、评审概念或演示时，或者当你描述一个用户问题并希望看到故事化呈现时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个故事板：一个忙碌的护士发现我们的自动排班系统。
say.note: Claude 会询问细节并生成 6 帧故事。

say.text: 为下周的产品评审会，做一个用户从困惑到解决的故事板。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成 7 个问题。

howto.what_en: Claude will ask you 7 questions, then generate a 6-frame storyboard showing a user's journey from problem to solution. Each frame includes text description and visual suggestions (default: fat-marker sketch style).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a fast narrative for alignment, concept reviews, or demos, or when you describe a user problem and want a storyboard.

say_en.text: Create a storyboard: a busy nurse discovers our auto-scheduling system.
say_en.note: Claude will ask details and generate 6 frames.

say_en.text: For next week's concept review, make a storyboard from confusion to solution.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through 7 questions.
